newsitem.title: LATVIA: Latvia's Ventspils sees lower reloadings in April.
newsitem.headline: Latvia's Ventspils sees lower reloadings in April.

text.p: Latvia's Ventspils oil terminal said on Monday it expected to reload less oil and oil products in April than in the same month last year because of lower diesel throughput from Russia.
The company in April last year reloaded one million tonnes of oil and oil products.

"We will never make one million (tonnes) as it was in 1996 because we have a considerably smaller amount of diesel arriving," the head of the company's despatch department, Imant Riekstinsh, told reporters.
He said that reloadings were running at around 15,000 tonnes to 17,000 tonnes a day compared with the average 20,000 tonnes to 25,000 tonnes.
Riekstinsh said less diesel was passing through the port as it was being used in Russia for the spring crop sowing season.
The Ventspils oil terminal is one of the main outlets for Russian crude oil and oil products.
